identity.name: Day-Date 40
identity.one_liner: The Day-Date 40 in platinum with a baguette-diamond bezel and an ice-blue dial — the most-cited modern Day-Date and the watch that made "President" a Rolex-tier synonym.

narrative.story: The Day-Date was introduced in 1956 and has been called the "President" since the introduction of the matching President bracelet in 1965. The 228396TBR is the platinum Day-Date 40 with a baguette-diamond bezel, sold since 2022. The 228206 (platinum smooth bezel) and 228239 (yellow gold fluted) and 228238 (yellow gold smooth) round out the Day-Date 40 family. The Day-Date 40 replaced the 41mm Day-Date II in 2015.
